sara_support: hi team — customer acct `acme-co` opened a ticket: their embeddings started returning 1536-d vectors while their client expects 768. happened ~3 hours ago after a deployment we rolled. they see API 200 but downstream error (shape mismatch). repro steps included below. can someone triage?
kevin_eng: thanks, looking. do we have request ids or example payloads?
sara_support: pasted request id from customer logs: `req_0a1b2c3d` and span `span-7a9`. sample curl they used:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"text-vector-lt","input":["hello world","doc 2"],"batch_size":8}'
```
kevin_eng: hmm model `text-vector-lt` should output 768 historically. checking model catalog and recent rollout. @maria_obs can you pull traces for `req_0a1b2c3d` and the embeddings route?
maria_obs: grabbing traces now. quick note: our tracer sample_rate was reduced to 0.02 in the EU region yesterday for perf experiment — may be sparse. i can still pull the full route span from our ingest (we keep traces for 7d).
opsbot: Support ticket #CS-45231 created, priority P1. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-45231
alex_oncall: got the trace. span shows kernel selection -> quantize -> postprocess steps. interesting line in the runtime log:
```
[INFO] 2024-04-05T14:02:11Z request=req_0a1b2c3d route=embeddings model=text-vector-lt kernel=fp16 quantized=false output_dim=1536 batch_count=1 duration_ms=92
```
alex_oncall: that output_dim jump suggests the route served a different model or a different model artifact variant (maybe a new revision with doubled dims).
kevin_eng: can the model loader map a model alias to a different architecture by mistake? looking at the deployment diff — there was a model swap: alias `text-vector-lt` pointed to v1.3 before, now points to v2.0 (internal name `text-vector-lt-v2`) which is 1536-d. looks like alias routing happened during the release.
sara_support: customer says they pinned `model: text-vector-lt` in their config; they didn't expect alias to change dims. are aliases allowed to change shape?
maria_obs: aliases can be remapped in config, but we should warn about shape changes. we have a mismatch detector but it only runs on model onboarding, not alias remaps.
kevin_eng: immediate mitigation: add a runtime check that rejects requests when model.output_dim != client.expected_dim if `expected_dim` header present — quick guard. also provide customer a temporary route to `text-vector-lt-v1` (the old artifact) while they migrate.
sara_support: customer asked for repro steps to run locally — shared this snippet to validate vector dim after call:
```python
import requests
r = requests.post('https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings', json={
  'model': 'text-vector-lt',
  'input': ['a'],
})
vec = r.json().get('data')[0]['embedding']
print(len(vec))
```
kevin_eng: re: observability — we should surface per-request dimension in the per-route dashboard and add an alert when dimension distribution changes. maria, can you add a temp panel and a histogram of `output_dim` for the embeddings route?
maria_obs: yes. added a one-off dashboard panel under Observability -> Embeddings -> Runtime Metrics showing count by `output_dim` and by `model_alias`. sampling note: i had to query raw spans because traces were sparse. query used:
```
index=traces route=embeddings | stats count by output_dim, model_alias | sort -count
```
alex_oncall: for the customer we can also recommend: set `X-Redwood-Expected-Dim: 768` header — if present the request will be validated and return 400 with explicit message if mismatch (we can enable this guard in the next hotfix).
kevin_eng: i'll open a PR for the guard and for adding a monitoring alert (pager on >20% of requests with unexpected dim in 5m). will also add a note to model alias docs.
sara_support: customer wants ETA — can we offer rollback to v1?
kevin_eng: yes, create a pinned route to `text-vector-lt-v1` for their account (can do via console). i'll do it and update ticket.
sara_support: perfect. thanks. please paste the console link when done. :thumbsup:
maria_obs: note for postmortem — the rollout pipeline allowed alias remap without a shape compatibility check. adding that to action items.
opsbot: Deployment event: model-alias-remap by deploy-ci user at 2024-04-05T13:58:52Z (audit id: audit-77b).
support-bot: customer notified: "We've created a pinned route to the previous model artifact and our engineers are rolling out a validation guard. We'll follow up in CS-45231."
kevin_eng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1427 — adds header-based dim-guard + alerting rule. will request review from @alex_oncall.
alex_oncall: reviewed, left one nit. will merge after tests. planning hotfix deploy in next 90 minutes.
sara_support: keeping customer updated. thanks everyone.
kevin_eng: follow-up: after enabling guard, we should run a quick traffic test to ensure no false positives for known multi-variant customers (some customers intentionally request different model_alias per call). probably need an allowlist per-account.
maria_obs: adding allowlist field to the alert rule ticket.
opsbot: Ticket CS-45231 transitioned to "in progress".
